description: This Java class 'SeoConfigUtil' is a utility for reading and processing SEO configuration from an XML file 'SeoConfig.xml'. It parses settings related to URL rewriting, category URL options, session ID handling, and character filters, providing static methods to access these configurations.

classes.name: SeoConfigUtil
classes.description: A utility class for loading and accessing SEO configuration settings from an XML file, including URL patterns, replacements, session ID handling, and category URL options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Loads and parses the SEO configuration XML file, initializing static configuration variables.

methods.name: isInitialed
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: checkUseUrlRegexp
methods.description: Indicates whether URL regular expressions are used based on configuration.

methods.name: getGeneralRegexpPattern
methods.description: Returns the general URL matching regex pattern.

methods.name: checkCategoryUrl
methods.description: Checks if category URL feature is enabled.

methods.name: isCategoryUrlEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific context path is enabled for category URL.

methods.name: isCategoryNameEnabled
methods.description: Checks if category name feature is enabled.

methods.name: getCategoryUrlSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix used for category URLs.

methods.name: isJSessionIdAnonEnabled
methods.description: Checks if JSESSIONID is enabled for anonymous sessions.

methods.name: isJSessionIdUserEnabled
methods.description: Checks if JSESSIONID is enabled for logged-in users.

methods.name: getUserExceptionPatterns
methods.description: Returns list of URL patterns exempted from session ID handling.

methods.name: getCharFilters
methods.description: Returns character filters applied during URL processing.

methods.name: getSeoPatterns
methods.description: Returns map of URL patterns to regex patterns for SEO URL matching.

methods.name: getSeoReplacements
methods.description: Returns map of URL patterns to replacement strings for SEO URLs.

methods.name: getForwardReplacements
methods.description: Returns map of URL patterns to forward replacements.

methods.name: getForwardResponseCodes
methods.description: Returns map of URL patterns to HTTP response codes for forwarding.

methods.name: isSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated: Checks if a product ID is marked as special.

methods.name: addSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated: Adds a product ID to the list of special product IDs.

methods.name: getSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated: Retrieves the original product ID from the special list.

methods.name: getDefaultResponseCode
methods.description: Returns the default HTTP response code for redirects.
